size_basis: L x W x H mm, issued envelope (X-MFG-38 tool line)

machine.type: in-house PV cell line per the node design block (X-MFG-38, A-M-178, AQS-DUTY-071): seven named stations drawn as envelopes with the node ratings, the diffusion station internally resolved per its node dims (quartz tube 200 mm x 1.0 m with the 200 mm ceramic-fibre annulus taken at face value), 3 cells per batch, KOH feed from WS_KOH

PV-TEX-01.node_text: KOH texture bath, 10 L PP tank, immersion heater

PV-EMIT-01.node_text: POCl3 diffusion, quartz tube 200 mm x 1.0 m, 200 mm ceramic fibre

PV-PSG-01.node_text: HF PSG etch, room temperature PP bath

PV-ARC-01.node_text: PECVD SiNx, parallel-plate RF, 5 kg heated platen, dry vacuum pump

emit_internals.tube: quartz OD 200 x 1000, wall 5 study (AQS-PV-001: tube quartz; the node design gives OD and length, not wall - hold W12)
emit_internals.fibre: 200 mm annulus (the node design text '200 mm ceramic fibre' taken at face value as the fibre thickness; A-M-178 fibre k basis)
emit_internals.legacy_note: AQS-PV-001 rev C carries the older 50 mm ID x 800 mm tube figure; the node design 200 mm x 1.0 m governs (hold W12)

machine.material_basis: duty section 3: 316L where the stream is wet; the node station texts name PP tanks/baths - the duty selection governs (plan rule 5; hold W12); the screen is stainless shop-cut and the tube quartz per AQS-PV-001 section 3
machine.guard: four-post hold-down frame (40 x 40 posts, top rails) is the A-MACH guard + 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)

N1.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; 50 datum is the schedule placeholder

N2.note: vent flush at the envelope top; the schedule datum 800 mm predates the 1600 box (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N3.note: atmospheric hose joint per duty section 4 (bore not calculated); solids row is a non-piped transfer: drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4)

N4.note: atmospheric hose joint per duty section 4 (bore not calculated); solids row is a non-piped transfer: drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric hose joints per duty section 4 (bore not calculated); the N3/N4 solids rows are non-piped transfers drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4); the N2 vent datum 800 predates the 1600 box (hold, W12); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
